name: INTERMISSION3
source:
Revy and her fellows have finished a big job, and due to the members' injuries, they have one month off period.

No dramatic gun scene, no sex with Rock, Revy was feeling frustrated...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ066287.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
莱薇与同伴们完成了一笔大买卖，但由于成员受伤，大家获得了一个月的休假。

没有惊心动魄的枪战，也无法与洛克做爱，莱薇感到十分憋闷……
